query:
SELECT
                    COALESCE(
                        JSONB_AGG(
                            JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('slug', r.application, 'admin', r.admin)
                        ),
                        '[]'::jsonb
                    ) AS "roles!: Json<Vec<Membership>>"
                FROM users u
                LEFT JOIN roles r ON r.uid = u.id
                WHERE u.id = $1
